I understand your concern regarding the delay in the city intimation slip for the ASO (Assistant Statistical Officer) Recruitment exam. If the information is not yet visible on the main Notice Board or Career page, I recommend the following steps to get the most current information:

1.  **Check the Examination General Notices:** Sometimes recruitment-related exam updates are posted specifically under the Examination section rather than the general notice board. You can check here: [https://kgmu.org/exam_notice.php](https://kgmu.org/exam_notice.php)

    *   **Phone:** 0522-2980514
    *   **Email:** coe@kgmcindia.edu

    *   **Phone:** 0522-2258880

It is possible there has been a slight administrative delay. I suggest calling the Registrar's office during working hours (9:00 AM to 4:00 PM) for a direct update.

entries.question: How to book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in).
*   **Phone:** Call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
*   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text "**APPOINTMENT <NAME>**" to **8887019134**.

**Important Instructions:**
*   Online registration is mandatory.
*   Please ensure you bring a printed copy of your appointment or the SMS confirmation when you visit the hospital.
*   Arrive at the hospital on the scheduled date and time.

If you have any symptoms or need medical advice, please consult a doctor at the **KGMU OPD**. For your safety, please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat.

entries.question: How to download admit card for recruitment of medical social welfare officer
entries.answer:
To download your admit card for a recruitment examination at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please follow these steps:

1.  Visit the official KGMU website: **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)**
2.  Navigate to the **Career** section or the **Notice Board** section on the homepage.
3.  Look for the specific recruitment notice for the "Medical Social Welfare Officer."
4.  There is usually a dedicated link for the **Entrance/Recruitment Examination Portal** or a specific **Admit Card Download** link provided within that notice.
5.  You will likely need to log in using your **Application Number/Registration ID** and **Date of Birth** or password.

If you are unable to find the link in the Career section, please check the **[Entrance Examination Registration Portal](https://kgmu.org/examportal.php)**, as recruitment-related admit cards are often hosted there.

**Important Note:** If the admit card link is not currently active, it means the university has not yet released it for the examination. Please keep an eye on the [Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) for updates regarding the release date.

If you face technical difficulties with the portal, you may contact the examination cell or the registrar's office using the contact details provided on the [Important Contact Numbers](https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php) page.

entries.question: Where is the career section navigated on the home page
entries.answer:
To find the **Career** section on the KGMU website, please follow these steps:

1.  Go to the official KGMU homepage: **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)**.
2.  Look at the **main navigation menu** (usually located towards the top of the page).
3.  Scroll your mouse cursor over the menu options. You will see a link labeled **"Career"** in the list.
4.  Alternatively, you can directly access the career and job-related notices by clicking this link: **[https://kgmu.org/job.php](https://kgmu.org/job.php)**.

If you are using a mobile device, you might need to click on the "three horizontal lines" (the hamburger menu) at the top or side of the screen to reveal the navigation menu, where you will find the "Career" link.

entries.question: Main kitne baje aa sakta hun
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD registration ka samay subah **8:30 AM se 11:45 AM** tak hai. 

Kripya dhyan dein:
1. **Online Appointment:** OPD mein dikhane ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par appointment book kar sakte hain.
2. **Helpline:** Appointment ya anya jaankari ke liye aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call kar sakte hain.
3. **SMS:** Aap "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhi bhej sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn suchna:**
* Main ek AI assistant hoon aur chikitsiya (medical) salah nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi gambhir samasya hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke Emergency/Trauma Centre ya nazdiki doctor se sampark karein.
* Apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number ya koi bhi personal health details share na karein.
